title: EARS-Info: Information-Aware Event-Driven Reallocation for Multi-Robot Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2610.38040v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce EARS-Info, an information-aware extension of Event-Driven Ant Reallocation Search for multi-robot exploration on OpenStreetMap-derived grids. It combines marginal sensing gain, feasible relocation, return-aware routing, sensing reservations, and cached shortest paths. Across 168,000 episodes comparing 30 implementations on eight city maps, EARS-Info achieves the highest mean operational score in every evaluation panel. With eight robots and 3% communication dropout, it improves the score over EARS-Safe by 5.43%, increases weighted discovery from 88.88% to 98.46%, and reduces mean energy use by 2.62%. Score differences are positive in all eight cities ($p=0.0078125$; descriptive 95% city-bootstrap interval $[0.0159,0.0694]$), with no simulated incidents across 5,600 EARS-Info episodes. translated_title: EARS-Info：面向多机器人探索的信息感知事件驱动重分配方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EARS-Info，这是事件驱动蚁群重分配搜索（EARS）的一种信息感知扩展方法，用于在由OpenStreetMap派生的网格上进行多机器人探索。该方法结合了边际感知增益、可行重定位、返回感知路由、感知预留以及缓存的最短路径。在八张城市地图上对30种实现进行共168,000回合的对比实验中，EARS-Info在每个评估面板中都取得了最高的平均运行分数。在八台机器人和3%通信丢率的条件下，其分数相比EARS-Safe提升了5.43%，加权发现率从88.88%提高到98.46%，平均能耗降低2.62%。分数差异在全部八个城市中均为正值（p=0.0078125；描述性95%城市自举置信区间为[0.0159,0.0694]），且在5,600次EARS-Info回合中未发生任何模拟事故。这些结果支持了完整控制器的有效性；但各单个组件的优势仍不确定。其泛化能力受限于重复使用的地理（数据），
tldr: EARS-Info通过融合边际感知增益、可行重定位、返回感知路由和缓存最短路径等机制，在八张城市地图的多机器人探索任务中全面超越EARS-Safe，实现了最高的平均运行分数、更高的发现率并降低能耗。
